_doc: Frozen independent source-grounded holdout labels, authored before inspecting new retriever/model outputs. Existing35 labels remain unchanged. These labels test retrieval of reported facts/identity within a bounded evidence set, not live recommendation satisfaction.

freeze_protocol.old_queries_compared: exact text equality only to ensure distinct query phrasings
freeze_protocol.policy: Do not edit this file in response to retrieval results. Any future correction requires a new dataset version with evidence, retaining this version.

relevance_scale.2: directly relevant named entity or source-supported requested feature

evaluation_limits: Known-positive labels do not establish exhaustive relevance across the full14006-place catalog or any changed catalog.
Named cases are exhaustive only among the30 reviewed physical entities. Global aliases and duplicate canonical records outside that set remain unjudged.
Generic free-Wi-Fi case has partial known-positive judgments: unknown Wi-Fi is not false.
Use MRR/Recall/nDCG as bounded retrieval diagnostics; precision or true-negative claims require independently judged result pools.
Do not use primary-source URLs as extra retriever input unless that is the explicitly declared evaluated corpus.
No report_only source claims, power outlets, quiet, wheelchair, safety, onsite availability or generic free-entry assumptions are positive labels.
Source_reported free Wi-Fi and scoped child offerings are neither onsite verified nor universal suitability guarantees.
